reading: The sketch is a team-management page: a page title and subtitle at top-left, a blue "+ Invite" button at top-right, a toolbar of filter/search controls, a dark selection bar for bulk actions, a large data table of team members (with an open status-filter dropdown overlaid on it), and a pager at the bottom — all annotated by typed notes giving exact copy, styling and column layout.
